Subject: Project update: new delivery date of 14 April

The third-party integration required for your project needed additional certification cycles beyond what the vendor originally estimated, and that process has now pushed our delivery date back by two weeks. We have confirmed the certification is on track and are locking in 14 April as the new delivery date.

In the meantime, our team is continuing work on every component that doesn't depend on the certification, so this delay affects only the final integration and testing phase rather than the full timeline. We'll also build in a short buffer around the certification handoff so a similar delay doesn't happen again. Does 14 April still work well with your own scheduling on your end, or is there a hard deadline we should know about?

We'll send a short progress update next week and confirm final testing dates as soon as certification is complete, so you have full visibility until launch. Thank you for your patience as we get this integration right rather than rushing it through.
